source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 10 iulie — «Sfântul Mucenic Apolonie»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 10ης Ιουλίου — «Άγιος Απολλώνιος από τις Σάρδεις»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 10 Ιουλίου εκάστου έτους», the same day the folder's Romanian row already carries, and the city in the Greek line is the folder's own byname: «Ο Άγιος Απολλώνιος καταγοταν από τις Σάρδεις». That, and the day, settle him against the corpus's three other men of the name — the companion of Proclus, the anchorite and the reader. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence, and the page prints no hymn under his line.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue as printed by pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (24 September 2026).
